Where the checkpoint finds fields

RS-02 · Fields of The World test chips · India and Slovenia

Sentinel-2, 10 m, two seasonal windows
object recall at IoU 0.5
project summary · full method

Each marker is one test chip, about 1.5 km across, coloured by the share of its hand-labelled parcels a method recovered. Pick a method above the map, and zoom in to a chip to see its labelled parcels, filled where the method found them and outlined in orange where it missed. FTW is shown twice: its v3 checkpoint, the best public release, and the v1 checkpoint this project first tested. In India v1 leaves almost every chip empty and v3 finds a good deal more, while the same imagery still gives untrained methods more to find. In Slovenia, where FTW was trained on a complete cadastre, it works.

How to read it

Indian chips carry about five hand-drawn parcels each and nothing else is labelled, so a chip's colour is the share of those five a method recovered. Slovenian chips carry a complete cadastre, about 37 parcels each.

Dashed rings are test chips with no labelled parcel, mostly forest in Slovenia.

Settings

Each untrained method is shown at the one setting whose objects per chip sit nearest FTW v3's count, so the methods spend a similar budget. SAM cannot draw as many objects as v3 in India, so it is shown with fewer. The headline figures in the project write-up are interpolated to the exact count and differ a little from the totals here.

What it does not show

Chip outcomes are a handful of parcels each, so a single chip is a weak signal. Read the pattern, and the district totals, rather than any one marker. The causes of the gap between the countries are discussed in the full write-up.

Data: Fields of The World (licence listed per country), Copernicus Sentinel-2, geoBoundaries state outlines (CC BY 4.0). Background: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2020 by EOX IT Services GmbH, contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2020 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). It is a natural-colour, cloud-free composite for orientation, not the imagery the methods were run on: the Indian labels were drawn on 2016 imagery and the Slovenian on 2021, so a field may have changed since, and SAM was given colour infrared. Parcel outlines are simplified to within one pixel for drawing. Map library: Leaflet. Built by src/build_map.py from the project's result files.
